title: Leveraging MIMIC Datasets for Better Digital Health: A Review on Open Problems, Progress Highlights, and Future Promises

bias_targets.methodology: Auditing predictive models (e.g., mortality prediction) for disparities in efficacy and accuracy across racial groups, and evaluating fairness-aware algorithms like adversarial debiasing and reweighting schemes.
